facts.why: The birthday in the film is Ricky's. Bella sings 'Ricky Baker Birthday Song' at a Casio keyboard by the candles, shortly after the pig scene.

facts.text: Bella's welcome tray, hot water bottle included.
facts.why: Bella tells Ricky she left a hottie in his bed on his first night, but no welcome tray appears.
facts.fix: Bella's welcome, hottie in the bed included.

facts.why: Ricky says he writes haikus to express his feelings and recites several, including 'Maggots' and one about his sore ankle.

vibe.verdict: A good bush hut look with pork, damper and Milo, though the birthday cake is credited to the wrong person.
